_note: Search queries come from watchlist.json. Optional per-retailer 'searchTerms' are appended as extra queries.

ebgames._note: PRIMARY TCG source. Per-store availability via /api/store/SearchStores; status is a red/yellow/green color per store.

londondrugs._note: Per-store availability via the PDP store picker: searches storeSearchPostal, scrapes the store cards, keeps targetStores matched by postal. Status badges seen: 'In Stock' / 'Available for pickup today' / 'Not In Stock'. fetchQuantity=true also reads each store's count ('61 Items in Stock') for in-stock rows: it loads the product once and switches stores in place (the picker reopens via 'Check Availability at Other Stores' once a store is set).
londondrugs._queryPrefix_note: LD is a general-merchandise store, so its search needs the brand token to surface TCG at all. Measured live: 'Ascended Heroes' and 'Moltres' each returned 0 results, while 'Pokemon Ascended Heroes' returned 2 and 'Pokemon Moltres' returned 16 — the bare queries were missing real products, not just returning junk. It only helps recall; LD still answers 'Pokemon 30th Anniversary' with U2 vinyl, so the watchlist 'require'/'exclude' title gate is what keeps results clean. NOT set for EB Games: it's a game store whose bare set-name searches already work, and it titles products 'Pokemon' with an accent.

superstore._note: DISABLED: RCSS lists no Pokemon TCG online (verified — snacks/plush/apparel only; cards are in-store impulse items not listed anywhere online). Nothing to scrape.
